select max(cxr.SCHEDULE_DATE) SCHEDULE_DATE, /*排程日期*/ max(cxr.CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, /*成型批次号*/ ci.SIDEWALL_CODE, /*胎侧代码*/ max(substr(ci.SIDEWALL_RUBBER,1, INSTR(concat(ci.SIDEWALL_RUBBER,'/'),'/')-1)) GLUE_CODE, /*胶料,施工信息表取的胶料代码是'/'分割的，默认只需要取第一个胶料*/ max(ci.SIDEWALL_RUBBER) WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, /*胶料代码(完整没有截取的)*/ max(ci.SIDEWALL_MOUTH_PLATE) MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, /*口型板代码*/ IFNULL(max(ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH),0) UNIT_CONSUME, /*单耗(胎侧长)*/ IFNULL(CEILING(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*对应成型一班的胎侧胶计划量=成型计划量*单耗/1000 */ IFNULL(CEILING(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的胎侧胶计划量*/ IFNULL(CEILING(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的胎侧胶计划量*/ IFNULL(CEILING(sum(cxr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*对应成型次日一班的胎侧胶计划量*/ IFNULL(CEILING(sum(cxr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN, /*对应成型次日二班的胎侧胶计划量*/ GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT concat(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,'$',cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,'$',cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION) order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION SEPARATOR ',') as quotaKeys /*机台code$胎胚代码*/, MAX(CASE WHEN cxr.remark = p.param_value THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG, /*收尾标记*/ IFNULL(MIN(CLASS2_SORT), 9) CLASS2_SORT, IFNULL(MIN(CLASS3_SORT), 9) CLASS3_SORT, IFNULL(MIN(CLASS4_SORT), 9) CLASS4_SORT from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ LEFT join t_tc_params p on p.param_code = 'CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_REMARK' where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.SIDEWALL_CODE

select concat(cxr.EMBRYO_CODE , ',' ,ci.EMBRYO_CODE) EMBRYO_CODE, /*成型排程胎胚代码，施工表的胎胚代码*/ concat(cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION , ',' , ci.EMBRYO_VERSION) as BOM_DATA_VERSION, /*成型排程胎胚版本，施工表的胎胚版本*/ ci.SIDEWALL_CODE, /*胎侧代码*/ ci.SIDEWALL_RUBBER, /*胎侧胶料代码*/ ci.SIDEWALL_MOUTH_PLATE, /*胎侧口型板*/ ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH /*胎侧长*/ from (select EMBRYO_CODE,BOM_DATA_VERSION from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where DEL_FLAG = 0 and schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 where 1=1
and (ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0' or ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE is null)

select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, SIDEWALL_CODE, GLUE_CODE, WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_SEQ, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, MACHINE_ID, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, IFNULL(DAY_PLAN_QTY,0) DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, IFNULL(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY,0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, PRE_PLAN_QTY, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from t_tc_schedule_result r where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DEL_FLAG = 0
mapper.update: -- 执行批量更新 UPDATE T_TC_SCHEDULE_RESULT as result JOIN temp_schedule_result tempTable ON result.id = tempTable.id SET result.day_plan_qty = tempTable.day_plan_qty, result.night_plan_qty = tempTable.night_plan_qty, result.day_produce_order = tempTable.day_produce_order, result.night_produce_order = tempTable.night_produce_order, result.is_release = IF(result.PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT = 0,'0','5'), result.update_by = tempTable.update_by, result.update_time = tempTable.update_time where result.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

-- 执行批量更新 UPDATE T_TC_SCHEDULE_RESULT as result JOIN temp_schedule_result tempTable ON result.id = tempTable.id SET result.day_plan_qty = tempTable.day_plan_qty, result.night_plan_qty = tempTable.night_plan_qty, result.pre_plan_qty = tempTable.pre_plan_qty, result.is_release = IF(result.PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT = 0,'0','5'), result.update_by = tempTable.update_by, result.update_time = tempTable.update_time where result.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

-- 创建临时表用于批量更新 CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE temp_schedule_result ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, day_plan_qty DOUBLE, day_produce_order INT, night_plan_qty DOUBLE, night_produce_order INT, pre_plan_qty DOUBLE, is_release CHAR(1), update_by VARCHAR(25), update_time DATETIME );

mapper.select: select MATERIAL_CODE from T_TC_ASSIST_SPEC where DEL_FLAG='0'

SELECT ci.SIDEWALL_CODE FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R INNER JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION INNER JOIN T_TC_PARAMS P ON P.PARAM_CODE = 'CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_REMARK' AND P.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND P.PARAM_VALUE IS NOT NULL WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
AND (REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS1_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS1_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS2_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS2_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS3_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS3_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS4_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS4_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS5_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R.CLASS5_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE))
AND NOT EXISTS /*同一个施工只看几天内最后一天的排产是否收尾*/ (SELECT 1 FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R2 LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI2 ON R2.EMBRYO_CODE = CI2.EMBRYO_CODE AND R2.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI2.EMBRYO_VERSION WHERE R2.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN R.SCHEDULE_DATE - #{closeOutDays} AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE AND CI2.SIDEWALL_CODE = CI.SIDEWALL_CODE AND r.id != r2.id AND R2.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI2.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI2.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R3 WHERE R3.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN R.SCHEDULE_DATE - #{closeOutDays} AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE AND R3.EMBRYO_CODE = R2.EMBRYO_CODE AND R3.BOM_DATA_VERSION = R2.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND R3.SCHEDULE_DATE > R2.SCHEDULE_DATE AND R3.DEL_FLAG = '0' )
AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS1_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS1_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS2_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS2_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS3_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS3_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS4_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS4_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS5_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(IFNULL(R2.CLASS5_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE)) GROUP BY CI.SIDEWALL_CODE
